name: 深圳
description: Shenzhen is China's first Special Economic Zone and a global tech hub. A modern megacity that transformed from a fishing village to one of the world's fastest-growing cities in just 40 years. Home to tech giants like Tencent, Huawei, and BYD. Features innovative architecture, theme parks, and easy access to Hong Kong.
highlights: Window of the World - Global landmarks

climate.tips: Best visited in winter (Nov-Feb) when weather is mild and pleasant. Summer is hot, humid with frequent typhoons. Spring is rainy. Always bring sunscreen and hydration.

attractions.name: 世界之窗
attractions.description: Theme park featuring miniature replicas of famous world landmarks including Eiffel Tower, pyramids, and Taj Mahal.
attractions.tips: Start early to cover all attractions. Evening is best for photos. Book tickets online for discount.

attractions.name: 华侨城创意园
attractions.description: Former industrial complex converted into vibrant arts and design hub with galleries, boutiques, cafes, and creative studios.
attractions.address: North Area of OCT, Nanshan District
attractions.tips: Best on weekends for markets and events. The area transforms during Chinese New Year with art exhibitions.

attractions.name: 大芬油画村
attractions.description: The world's largest oil painting production base, where millions of replicas of famous artworks are painted. Now also an art destination.
attractions.tips: Bargaining expected when buying paintings. Quality varies widely. Commission paintings on-site at reasonable prices.

attractions.name: 深圳湾公园
attractions.description: Coastal park along Shenzhen Bay with scenic waterfront, mangroves, bird watching, and Hong Kong skyline views.
attractions.tips: Best at sunset for Hong Kong skyline photos. Morning for bird watching. Bring binoculars.

attractions.name: 海上世界
attractions.description: Italian-themed waterfront complex centered on a historic Italian cruise ship, featuring restaurants, bars, and entertainment.
attractions.tips: Evening visit recommended for atmosphere. Great for seafood restaurants. Take ferry from Hong Kong for scenic arrival.

attractions.name: 欢乐谷
attractions.description: Large amusement park with roller coasters, water rides, and performances for all ages.
attractions.tips: Weekday visits avoid crowds. Height restrictions on rides. Re-entry allowed with hand stamp.

attractions.name: 平安金融中心
attractions.description: The second tallest building in China with observation deck offering panoramic city views from 542 meters.
attractions.tips: Book tickets online to avoid queues. Go at sunset for day and night views. Avoid foggy days.

attractions.name: 海岸城
attractions.description: Large waterfront shopping complex with international brands, restaurants, and entertainment in Nanshan.
attractions.tips: Good for rainy days. Connected to Metro. Excellent restaurants on upper floors.

attractions.name: 东部华侨城
attractions.description: Large ecological tourism zone with Tea Valley theme park, Grand Canyon Cloud Sea Valley, and hot springs. Combines natural scenery with entertainment.
attractions.tips: Stay overnight at the resort hotel for full experience. Wear comfortable shoes for hiking.

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨公园
attractions.description: Popular sandy beach with clear waters and scenic coastline. Free entry public beach with facilities.
attractions.tips: Arrive early on weekends to avoid crowds. No outside food allowed. Rent umbrella and chair on-site.

attractions.name: 小梅沙海洋世界
attractions.description: Marine aquarium with dolphin shows, polar exhibits, and underwater tunnels. Great for families.
attractions.tips: Shows at scheduled times, check schedule on arrival. Good for rainy days.

attractions.name: 荷兰花卉小镇
attractions.description: European-style flower market with Dutch architecture, flower shops, and cafes. Free entry.
attractions.tips: Best in spring for flower displays. Popular for wedding photos. Great for Instagram shots.

attractions.name: 甘坑古镇
attractions.description: Historical Hakka village with traditional architecture, museums, and local snacks. Evening lighting spectacular.
attractions.tips: Visit in late afternoon to see both day and night scenes. Try Hakka specialties.

attractions.name: 观澜版画村
attractions.description: Traditional Hakka village turned artist colony. Known for printmaking and traditional buildings.
attractions.tips: Combine with nearby Guanlan Hot Spring. Morning visits best for photos.

attractions.name: 大鹏所城
attractions.description: 600-year-old Ming Dynasty coastal fortress. Birthplace of China's modern navy and Hakka culture.
attractions.tips: Combine with nearby beaches. Try Dapeng cuisine. Half-day trip recommended.

attractions.name: 较场尾海滩
attractions.description: Popular beach destination known for surfing, beach bars, and colorful seaside cabins.
attractions.tips: Known as 'Shenzhen's Bali'. Stay overnight for beach party atmosphere. Try fresh seafood.

attractions.name: 观澜湖高尔夫
attractions.description: World's largest golf club with 12 courses. Hosts international tournaments.
attractions.tips: Book in advance. Non-golfers can enjoy spa and restaurants. Stay at resort hotel.

attractions.name: 深圳博物馆
attractions.description: Modern museum showcasing Shenzhen's history from fishing village to megacity. Free entry.
attractions.tips: Combine with nearby Shenzhen Convention Center. Good for rainy days.

attractions.name: 春 节
attractions.description: Major citywide celebrations during Chinese New Year with flowers, lights, and cultural events.
attractions.tips: Book hotels early. City empties after 3rd day. Good time to visit theme parks without crowds.

attractions.name: 大梅沙海滨公园
attractions.description: Popular coastal park with sandy beach and recreational facilities.
attractions.tips: Best on weekdays to avoid crowds. Take sun protection.

attractions.name: 莲花山公园
attractions.description: A landmark park in the central area of Shenzhen, with a bronze statue of Deng Xiaoping at the summit. From the top, you can overlook the Shenzhen CBD skyline and the Civic Center. It is a popular spot for local residents to relax and for tourists to check in.
attractions.tips: Climb to the top in the evening to watch the sunset and the CBD lights. There are kite performances on weekends.

attractions.name: 东门步行街
attractions.description: The oldest commercial district in Shenzhen, with a history of over 300 years. Today, it is a shopping paradise for young people, gathering various trendy clothing, snacks, and entertainment venues, with extremely heavy foot traffic.
attractions.address: Middle Dongmen Road, Luohu District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: There are many people on weekends. Be careful of pickpockets. You can bargain when shopping.

attractions.name: 华强北
attractions.description: The world's largest electronic products distribution center, known as 'China's First Electronic Street'. Here you can find various electronic products, components, and digital accessories, making it a paradise for tech enthusiasts.
attractions.address: North Huaqiang Road, Futian District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: Bargaining is a must. Pay attention to product quality. You can spend half a day browsing and still not have enough time.

attractions.name: 南头古城
attractions.description: The oldest city in Shenzhen, with a history of over 1,700 years. After renovation, it blends traditional Lingnan architecture with modern cultural and creative spaces, epitomizing the fusion of Shenzhen's history and modernity.
attractions.address: Nantou Ancient City, Nanshan District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: After the renovation, the ancient city has many trendy shops. It's great for taking photos and tasting food.

attractions.name: 深圳图书馆
attractions.description: A modern library in Shenzhen's central area, with avant-garde architectural design and a rich collection of books. It is the main venue for Shenzhen's Reading Month activities and a cultural space for citizens to study and relax.
attractions.tips: You can get a library card for free. It's adjacent to the concert hall and children's palace, so you can visit them together.

attractions.name: 深圳音乐厅
attractions.description: A modern concert hall designed by Japanese architect Arata Isozaki, with a unique architectural shape like a golden hall. It is the main venue for large-scale symphony and concerts in Shenzhen.
attractions.tips: It is recommended to purchase tickets in advance. The building's exterior is also worth photographing.

attractions.name: 深圳市民中心
attractions.description: The seat of the Shenzhen municipal government, with an architectural design resembling a giant penguin spreading its wings, it is one of Shenzhen's landmark buildings. The square is vast and serves as a venue for major events and public leisure activities.
attractions.address: No. 3 Fuzhong Road, Futian District, Shenzhen
attractions.openingHours: The square is open all day
attractions.tips: There is a light show performance in the evening. It can be visited together with Lianhua Mountain Park.

attractions.name: 深圳湾大桥
attractions.description: A cross-sea bridge connecting Shenzhen and Hong Kong, with a total length of 5.5 kilometers. From Shenzhen Bay Park, you can have a panoramic view of the bridge, and it is an important passage connecting Shenzhen and Hong Kong.
attractions.tips: You can capture a panoramic view of the bridge at Shenzhen Bay Park. It is most beautiful at sunset in the evening.

attractions.name: 仙湖植物园
attractions.description: The largest botanical garden in Shenzhen, covering an area of 546 hectares. It features attractions such as Hongfa Temple, Fossil Forest, and Xianhu Lake, integrating plant research, science education, and tourism and leisure.
attractions.address: No. 160 Xianhu Road, Liantang, Luohu District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: It is recommended to take the park shuttle to the top of the mountain and then walk down. Hongfa Temple offers free incense.

attractions.name: 深圳大学
attractions.description: The first comprehensive university in Shenzhen, with a beautiful campus and modern architectural style. It is the cradle for cultivating innovative talents in Shenzhen, where renowned entrepreneurs such as Ma Huateng graduated.
attractions.address: No. 3688 Nanhai Avenue, Nanshan District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: You can take a stroll on campus to feel the university atmosphere. The nearby Guimiao New Village has many delicious foods.

attractions.name: 星河COCO Park
attractions.description: A large shopping center in Shenzhen's Futian CBD, integrating shopping, dining, and entertainment. It features various international brands and specialty restaurants, and is a major venue for white-collar leisure and consumption in Shenzhen.
attractions.address: Fuhua Third Road, Futian District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: Crowded on weekends. Direct access via Shopping Park metro station. There are many bars nearby.

attractions.name: 深圳红树林海滨生态公园
attractions.description: A mangrove reserve by Shenzhen Bay, one of the most important ecological green spaces in Shenzhen. A large number of migratory birds inhabit here every year, making it a great place for birdwatching and getting close to nature.
attractions.address: By Shenzhen Bay, Futian District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: The most birds appear in autumn and winter. Bring binoculars for a better viewing experience.

attractions.name: 锦绣中华民俗村
attractions.description: One of China's earliest theme parks, featuring a miniature landscape area with scaled-down replicas of famous attractions across China, and a folk culture village showcasing the architecture and culture of various ethnic minorities.
attractions.address: No. 9003 Shennan Avenue, Nanshan District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: The evening ethnic song and dance performances are spectacular. It's recommended to enter the park in the afternoon and stay for the evening show before leaving.

attractions.name: 关山月美术馆
attractions.description: An art museum named after the renowned Chinese painter Guan Shanyue, housing and displaying his works and contemporary Chinese paintings. It is an important art exhibition venue in Shenzhen.
attractions.address: No. 6026 Hongli Road, Futian District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: It frequently hosts various free art exhibitions. You can visit it together with Lianhua Hill Park.

attractions.name: 欢乐港湾
attractions.description: A large seaside cultural park in Qianhai, Shenzhen, featuring the Bay Light Ferris Wheel and a seaside boardwalk. The Ferris wheel is 128 meters tall, offering panoramic views of Qianhai and Bao'an.
attractions.tips: Taking the Ferris wheel in the evening offers views of the sunset and the night skyline. It gets crowded on weekends.

attractions.name: 蛇口海上世界文化艺术中心
attractions.nameEn: Sea World Culture and Arts Center
attractions.description: Designed by Japanese architect Fumihiko Maki, this seaside cultural and arts center regularly hosts various art exhibitions and cultural events. The building itself is a work of art, facing the sea.
attractions.tips: Can be visited together with Sea World. The building's exterior is great for photos.

attractions.name: 观澜山水田园
attractions.description: A large ecological tourism scenic area in Longhua District, featuring hot springs, farms, an expansion base, and a water park. It is an ideal place for Shenzhen urbanites to return to nature and experience rural life.
attractions.tips: Suitable for family outings. Hot springs require a separate ticket.

attractions.name: 笔架山公园
attractions.description: An urban park in Futian District, Shenzhen, named for its mountain shape resembling a pen rest. It has hiking trails, observation decks, and sports facilities, making it a great place for morning exercise and weekend leisure.
attractions.tips: The mountaintop offers a panoramic view of Shenzhen's CBD. Suitable for early morning exercise.

attractions.name: 荔枝公园
attractions.description: One of Shenzhen's earliest parks, named for its lychee trees. With lakes, mountains, pavilions, and towers, it is an oasis in the bustling city.
attractions.address: 1001 Hongling Middle Road, Futian District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: The lychee ripening season from June to July is the most interesting time. Evening strolls are very pleasant.

attractions.name: 大南山公园
attractions.description: A city mountain park in Nanshan District, with an altitude of 336 meters. From the summit, you can overlook Shenzhen Bay, Shekou Port, and Yuen Long in Hong Kong, making it one of the best viewpoints in Shenzhen.
attractions.tips: It is recommended to hike up in the afternoon to watch the sunset. Bring plenty of water and mosquito repellent.

attractions.name: 前海深港合作区
attractions.description: An emerging business district in Qianhai, Shenzhen, representing the future development direction of the city. It is home to numerous modern buildings and innovative enterprises, serving as a new landmark of Shenzhen's reform and opening-up.
attractions.openingHours: Exterior can be visited all day
attractions.tips: The main attractions are the architecture and urban planning. It can be visited together with Happy Harbor.

attractions.name: 深圳客家民俗博物馆
attractions.description: A thematic museum showcasing the Hakka culture and history of Shenzhen, located in Hehu New Residence, Longgang District. Hehu New Residence is one of the largest Hakka enclosed houses in China, with magnificent architecture.
attractions.address: Nanlian Community, Longgang Street, Longgang District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: Can be visited together with Gankeng Ancient Town. Learn about the indigenous culture of Shenzhen.

attractions.name: 大鹏半岛国家地质公园
attractions.description: A national geopark featuring volcanic rock landforms and coastal geological landscapes. It has geological wonders such as sea caves and volcanic rock columns, making it a rare natural hidden gem in Shenzhen.
attractions.address: Dapeng Peninsula, Dapeng New District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: It is recommended to drive there. The coastal boardwalk offers stunning views, but be careful for safety.

attractions.name: 西涌海滩
attractions.description: The longest and most beautiful beach in Shenzhen, about 4 kilometers long. With fine sand and clear water, it is known as the Maldives of Shenzhen. It is the best seaside resort destination in Shenzhen.
attractions.address: Xichong, Nanao Street, Dapeng New District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: Crowded on weekends and holidays. You can camp and watch the sunrise. Pay attention to sun protection and safety.

attractions.name: 东涌海滩
attractions.description: A pristine beach on Dapeng Peninsula, quieter and more primitive than Xichong. The water is crystal clear, suitable for snorkeling and swimming. It is a secret beach for locals in Shenzhen.
attractions.address: Dongchong, Nanao Street, Dapeng New District, Shenzhen
highlights: The sea water is crystal clear.
attractions.tips: Suitable for those who prefer peace and quiet. Facilities are fewer than at Xichong, so bring your own food and water.

attractions.name: 杨梅坑
attractions.description: A beautiful bay on the Dapeng Peninsula, famous for cycling and sea views. The coastal cycling path offers scenic views and is one of Shenzhen's most popular cycling routes, as well as a popular spot for wedding photography.
attractions.address: Yangmeikeng, Nanao Street, Dapeng New District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: It is recommended to rent a bicycle and cycle along the coast. Weekends are crowded; weekdays are better.

attractions.name: 人才公园
attractions.description: A seaside park by Shenzhen Bay, themed around 'talent'. It features popular photo spots like Star Bridge and Pi Bridge, making it a new leisure destination in Shenzhen.
attractions.address: Shahe West Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: The sunset is most beautiful in the evening. You can visit it together with Shenzhen Bay Park.

attractions.name: 香蜜公园
attractions.description: A large urban park in Futian District, with a rose garden, flower fields, and an artificial lake. It is one of Shenzhen's most beautiful city parks, with flowers blooming all year round, and is a popular spot for wedding photography.
attractions.tips: Spring is the most beautiful season for flowers. It is suitable for walking and taking photos.

attractions.name: 欢乐海岸
attractions.description: A large waterfront cultural and commercial area developed by OCT Group, featuring shopping malls, cinemas, restaurants, and a water show theater. It is one of Shenzhen's liveliest leisure spots at night.
attractions.address: No. 8 East Baishi Road, Nanshan District, Shenzhen
attractions.tips: The evening water show is spectacular. It can be visited together with Shenzhen Bay Park.

attractions.name: 大芬油画村美术馆
attractions.nameEn: Dafen Oil Painting Village Art Museum
attractions.description: A professional art museum in Dafen Village, showcasing the transformation from oil painting reproduction to original art. It houses a large collection of original oil paintings and serves as an important window into the artistic development of Dafen Village.
attractions.tips: It can be visited together with Dafen Oil Painting Village. The free exhibitions are of high quality.

arrival.frequency: Daily flights from Asia, Europe, Americas

culturalTips.title: Tech Culture
culturalTips.content: Shenzhen is China's tech hub. Visit Huaqiangbei electronics market for gadgets. Experience cashless society firsthand.

culturalTips.title: Fast Pace
culturalTips.content: Shenzhen is always moving. Metro is packed during rush hours (7:30-9:00, 17:30-19:30). Plan accordingly.

culturalTips.title: Dining Hours
culturalTips.content: Local restaurants busy during normal meal times: 11:30-13:30 and 17:30-20:30. Late-night dining common.

culturalTips.title: Language
culturalTips.content: Mandarin is primary. Cantonese widely spoken in Luohu and traditional areas. English more common in tourist areas.

culturalTips.title: Huaqiangbei Electronics Market
culturalTips.content: The world's largest electronics market at Huaqiangbei. Bargain hard, check quality carefully, and verify specifications before purchase. Bring your laptop to test components.

culturalTips.title: Startup Ecosystem
culturalTips.content: Shenzhen is home to Tencent, Huawei, BYD, and DJI. Visit Tencent's headquarters in Nanshan. The city has a unique entrepreneurial spirit born from reform and opening.

culturalTips.title: Cashless Society
culturalTips.content: Mobile payment is universal in Shenzhen. Alipay and WeChat Pay are used for everything from street food to taxis. Bring a phone with these apps installed.

culturalTips.title: Beach Culture
culturalTips.content: Shenzhen has beautiful beaches (Dameisha, Xiaomeisha, Jiaochangwei). Arrive early on weekends as they get crowded. Bring sunscreen - shade is limited.

culturalTips.title: Cantonese Influence
culturalTips.content: While Mandarin dominates, Cantonese is still widely spoken in Luohu, Dongmen, and traditional Hakka areas. Locals appreciate when visitors try basic phrases.

culturalTips.title: Hong Kong Access
culturalTips.content: Shenzhen is gateway to Hong Kong via Luohu or Futian Checkpoint. Consider a day trip to Hong Kong or use Shenzhen as base for Pearl River Delta exploration.

culturalTips.title: Theme Park Culture
culturalTips.content: Shenzhen has major theme parks (Window of the World, Happy Valley, OCT Eastern). Book tickets online for discounts. Weekdays are less crowded.

culturalTips.title: Fashion and Design
culturalTips.content: OCT-LOFT and Dapeng Fortress host creative festivals. Shenzhen Fashion Week showcases local designers. The city blends innovation with manufacturing.

culturalTips.title: Reform History
culturalTips.content: Shenzhen was a fishing village in 1980. Now it's 17+ million people. Visit Shenzhen Museum to understand this remarkable transformation.

culturalTips.title: Teochew Dialect
culturalTips.content: Shenzhen has a large Teochew (Chaozhou) population from the Chaoshan region. Their cuisine and culture influence local dining. Try Chaoshan beef hot pot.

culturalTips.title: Seafood Dining
culturalTips.content: Coastal location means fresh seafood is abundant. Shekou and Dapeng have excellent seafood restaurants. Live tanks are common - pick your own.

culturalTips.title: Nightlife Scene
culturalTips.content: Sea World (Haishang Shijie) in Shekou has vibrant nightlife with international bars. Coastal City and COCO Park also have good evening options.

culturalTips.title: Art Scene
culturalTips.content: Dafen Oil Painting Village creates 60% of world's oil paintings. OCT-LOFT hosts indie music and design events. Art is big business here.

culturalTips.title: Typhoon Season
culturalTips.content: Shenzhen typhoon season is July-September. Check weather before beach trips. Major typhoons cause transit shutdowns - stay indoors.

culturalTips.title: Modern Architecture
culturalTips.content: Shenzhen has iconic modern architecture: Ping An Finance Center (599m), Shenzhen Civic Center by Mario Botta. Architecture tours are popular.

culturalTips.title: Business Hub
culturalTips.content: Shenzhen is China's Silicon Valley. Many tech companies recruit internationally. Business culture is fast-paced and efficiency-focused.
